note: Report figures are all-share fund portfolios; return and fee figures are A shares. Static model losses are not realized drawdown and are not a future loss bound. Operating fees exclude other expenses and personal transaction fees.

007364.field: wealth = 1 + official cumulative return decimal (second underscore-delimited data field), not cumulative NAV

source_stitching.merge_rule: Use common identical wealth observations; one-year file extends historical file; exclude observations after analysis cutoff

007364.sampling_note: First published observations are 2019-12-06, 2019-12-13, 2019-12-20 (weekly); subsequently primarily daily published NAV observations. Does not capture unpublished dates or intraday loss.
007364.peak_tie_rule: When the same high wealth repeats, retain first occurrence as peak date.

rate_sensitivity.scenario: Other variables unchanged, interest rates rise 25 basis points

019929.risk_metrics_limit: No complete common-window daily total-return series collected; maximum drawdown not supplied
019929.contract_scope_note: At least 80% of non-cash fund assets invested in index constituents and alternatives with remaining maturity 0–2 years; other permitted investment restricted to policy-bank bonds, repo and deposits. Fund name is not a duration cap for all holdings.
